INC-1063 Fume-hood H-2 low face velocity
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

Hood H-2 measured 0.31 m/s face velocity during the monthly check, below the 0.4 m/s limit. Work in the hood was stopped. Cause: a partially closed exhaust damper. The damper was reset and the hood passed a retest.

INC-1066 Fume-hood H-4 sash sensor fault
[Synthetic example written for this benchmark; all names, numbers and events are fictional.]

The sash height sensor on hood H-4 reported the sash closed while it was fully open, so the low-flow alarm was suppressed. Cause: sensor cable pinched by the sash counterweight. The cable was rerouted and the sensor replaced.
